It is no secret that Communist China is working to destroy America and our way of life – and Xi will use any tool necessary, including AI, to do it. The threats posed by Chinese tech are a massive economic security vulnerability and national security threat for the United States, and as our armed forces train to continue to be the most lethal fighting force on the planet, aggressive action needs to be taken to prevent critical data from being stolen or our systems from being tainted by adversaries.

My heart is shattered by the loss of this young Floridian. As we pray for Sewell’s family, we must act to stop this from happening again.

It’s time to pass my ASK Act to protect our kids from AI & give parents the power to decide what their kids are exposed to online. https://t.co/cGPTLDXqoA

Thank you Pres. Trump & @howardlutnick for holding Communist China accountable for stealing our AI technology & weaponizing it to undermine our national security. Communist China has chosen to be our adversary, & no American company should be helping them. https://t.co/rUORcLzWr5

The Communist Chinese regime will use any means necessary to spy, steal, and undermine the United States, and as AI technology advances, we must do more to protect our national security and stop adversarial regimes from using technology against us. With clear evidence that China can have access to U.S. user data on AI systems, it’s absolutely insane for our own federal agencies to be using these dangerous platforms and subject our government to Beijing’s control.

With clear evidence that Communist China can access U.S. user data on AI, it’s insane for our federal agencies to use AI built by our adversaries. 

Our No Adversarial AI Act will stop this threat & keep America’s data out of enemy hands. https://t.co/CNLSHfqlQA

AI is creating a world of possibilities; it’s also creating new National Security threats. We need to keep our country SAFE and STRONG.

My Generative AI Terrorism Risk Assessment Act would ensure the federal government is putting out regular, PUBLIC threat assessments on how terror groups are using AI.

Artificial Intelligence can be a fantastic tool, but we have to use it right. Students using AI as a replacement for human interaction is a threat to their personal development. We can’t let this happen.

My new bill, the Safeguard Kids Act, promotes AI literacy while protecting students through specialized counseling programs.

Artificial Intelligence has the potential to be the greatest information innovation since the printing press, but technology is only as good as our ability to use it well and for the right reasons. We cannot let AI be the wild west and hope our kids figure it out; that doesn’t work. It’s on us to guide them as they grow. We need to teach kids about the risks associated with AI, so they can be the kind of principled innovators, leaders, and job creators America’s future economy needs.

The allegations that led to this settlement are deeply concerning.

As parents and grandparents, we must do everything we can to keep our kids safe from the risks posed by social media and AI. 

That starts with educating our kids at a young age, which is why I’m fighting to pass my Safeguard Kids Act to better protect them from AI-related risks.

Artificial intelligence can be a powerful tool when used correctly, but it also carries risks. 

AI poses a significant threat to our kids and grandkids, and we need to educate them about the risks. My Safeguard Kids Act opens up federal resources to better protect, prepare, and equip children for the AI future.

I agree with @DavidSacks. AI isn’t going anywhere, so we need a plan to move forward safely, with America leading the way.

These companies have said what they are building could kill mankind. Seems pretty obvious they need to slow down now. But these companies can’t just raise their hands and say Congress has to do something.

We can’t lose to Communist China, obviously. If America doesn’t lead, we allow Communist China to make the rules and develop truly dangerous AI that will hurt Americans, especially our kids.

Congress is a mess right now. We can’t even pass election security protections. But AI regulations shouldn’t be rushed. It has to be thoughtful, so that is not going to happen this year.

AI companies need to be good corporate citizens, protect our kids' safety online and do the right thing without fear of their bottom line.

AI is not going anywhere. We’ve got to move forward, and we’ve got to do it safely. We’ve got to be the leader. We can’t lose to China. We can’t allow China, in any area, to set the rules because, you know what, it will be harmful to Americans.
If you’re building something that’s going to destroy mankind, you have a responsibility to act responsibly. [...] We’ve got to protect our citizens. We’ve got to especially protect our kids’ safety.

Americans are proud of what we make, and we want to support MADE IN AMERICA products, but we need good information to do that. 

Right now, AI chatbots on Walmart and Amazon are falsely claiming the products they sell are made in America. That’s wrong.

Consumers should know where their products are made. @SenatorBaldwin and I are calling for an FTC investigation.

I think first we need to be focused on kids safety. I think that's something we actually can do right now. I've got a bill. Others have bills. … But with regard to destroying mankind, these companies need to do the right thing on their own. We're not going to get smart enough to regulate them.

Americans want to buy AMERICAN-MADE products. But, they need accurate information about where products are made.

I joined @SenatorBaldwin in calling on the FTC to investigate the accuracy of AI chatbots on Walmart and Amazon identitying products as made in America.
